degree.zh: 信息技术硕士 · 人工智能方向
degree.en: Master of Information Technology · Artificial Intelligence

intro.zh: 我在新南威尔士大学学习信息技术，方向为人工智能。目前关注视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的数据、训练与评测，以及机器人学习中的推理效率。这里记录我的项目与实践。
intro.en: I study Information Technology with a focus on Artificial Intelligence at UNSW Sydney. My current interests are data, training, and evaluation for vision-language-action (VLA) models, alongside inference efficiency in robot learning. This site brings together my projects and practical work.

title.zh: 🎓 新南威尔士大学 · 信息技术硕士
title.en: 🎓 Master of Information Technology @ UNSW Sydney

description.zh: 预计 2027 年 8 月毕业

title.zh: SmolVLA Flow-Matching 动作专家蒸馏与异步闭环优化
title.en: SmolVLA Flow-Matching: Action Expert Distillation and Asynchronous Control

description.zh: 在统一的 LIBERO 任务协议下比较 ACT、Diffusion Policy 与不同推理步数的 SmolVLA，研究策略成功率与推理效率之间的取舍。
description.en: Comparing ACT, Diffusion Policy, and SmolVLA with different inference step counts under a shared LIBERO task protocol, studying the trade-offs between policy success and inference efficiency.

title.zh: 开放词汇多模态视频自动标注

description.zh: 基于 X-AnyLabeling、YOLOE 与 SAM 2 构建视频自动标注流程，关注遮挡后的身份恢复与跨帧轨迹一致性。
description.en: Building a video annotation workflow with X-AnyLabeling, YOLOE, and SAM 2, with a focus on identity recovery after occlusion and consistent trajectories across frames.

title.zh: 端侧实时姿态感知与运动事件识别
title.en: Real-Time Pose Perception and Sports Event Recognition

description.zh: 面向移动设备的视频分析，结合姿态检测、目标跟踪与时序状态机识别运动事件。
description.en: Video analysis on mobile devices, combining pose detection, object tracking, and temporal state machines to recognize sports events.

title.zh: 多视角 3D 姿态重建与轨迹稳定化
title.en: Multi-View 3D Pose Reconstruction and Trajectory Stabilization

description.zh: 从多机位视频与二维关键点重建三维骨架，通过置信度过滤与轨迹平滑提升输出稳定性。
description.en: Reconstructing 3D skeletons from multi-camera video and 2D keypoints, using confidence filtering and trajectory smoothing to improve stability.

description.zh: 参与视频自动标注、端侧运动事件识别与多视角三维姿态重建。
description.en: Worked on video annotation, on-device sports event recognition, and multi-view 3D pose reconstruction.
